author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a slow rocking beat, high and low, soft and loud, and calming down together, with the lullaby Brahms wrote for a friend's baby.

classes.title: Rock like a cradle
classes.goal: Hear the whole lullaby and rock slowly to its gentle beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling a slow swing that comes again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Hold your child close and rock slowly, one big rock for each swing of the tune.
classes.childAction: Rock slowly with the song, soft as a sleepy yawn.
classes.bridge: The beat is a cradle: rock... and rock... slow and gentle.

intro.caption: Time for a sleepy song
intro.parentCue: hold your child close and rock slowly.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling a slow beat and calming together.

classes.title: Good night, good night
classes.goal: Tap one gentle tap on each beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand on your child's hand; tap softly together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key gently once on every beat.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one rock of the cradle; one soft tap for each.

intro.caption: One beat, one gentle tap
intro.parentCue: tap your child's knee softly on each beat.

games.caption: Good night, and good night again
games.parentCue: Whisper 'one, two' for the two good nights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one gentle tap for each beat.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds, and hear the tune leap up and settle down.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing the tune jump up high, then float back down low

classes.parentPrompt: Growl and crouch for the bear; flap your arms and stretch up for the bird.
classes.childAction: Bear: tap the left side. Bird: tap the right side.
classes.bridge: Low notes are a heavy bear on the left; high notes are a bird.

intro.caption: The bear lives down low
intro.parentCue: point left for the bear, then right for the bird.

games.caption: Low, then way up high
games.parentCue: Lift your child's hands on the high note

games.caption: Down, down, down to bed
games.parentCue: Lower your hands slowly to the lap

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low, up and down.

classes.title: Big stretch, tiny whisper
classes.goal: Tap the beat with big loud taps, then with tiny soft taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: Noticing big and small: the same tap, more or less

classes.parentPrompt: Make big strong arms for loud taps; whisper and tiptoe your fingers for soft.
classes.childAction: Loud: big stretchy taps. Soft: tiny whisper taps.
classes.bridge: Loud taps are a big morning stretch; soft taps are a goodnight whisper.

intro.caption: Big loud taps, tiny soft taps
intro.parentCue: loud means strong arms, never banging.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing loud and soft.

classes.title: Sleepy slow, awake fast
classes.goal: Follow the music as it goes slow and sleepy, then fast and awake.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same tune, same shape, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers up your child's back, slowly then quickly, with the music.
classes.childAction: Slow music: sleepy taps. Fast music: wide-awake taps.
classes.bridge: Slow taps are heavy sleepy eyes; fast taps are wide-awake wiggles.

intro.caption: Sleepy slow, awake fast
intro.parentCue: slow down if the taps get wild.

games.caption: The wide-awake lullaby
games.parentCue: Same song, now quick and light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following slow and fast music.

classes.title: Shh... and freeze
classes.goal: Tap while the music plays and freeze when it stops.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the sound stops, the hands stop too

classes.parentPrompt: Freeze with a sleepy face when the music stops; smile when it starts again.
classes.childAction: Tap while the music plays. Hold very still when it stops.
classes.bridge: Music on, the cradle rocks; music off, we hold still like sleeping babies.

intro.caption: Tap, tap... and freeze!
intro.parentCue: make freezing a quiet game, eyes closed.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for stop and go.

classes.title: Rock-a-bye duet
classes.goal: Make the song together: the grown-up plays the tune, the child keeps the beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together to make one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune slowly and watch your child; if they stop, keep playing softly.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat softly on any key while your grown-up plays.
classes.bridge: The tune is the lullaby; your beat is the cradle that rocks it.

intro.caption: I play, you tap
intro.parentCue: sit side by side at the piano.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, two jobs.

classes.title: A lullaby for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song softly for teddy, then tuck teddy in together.

mathTarget.parentLine: The song ends on a long, low home note, ready for sleep

classes.parentPrompt: Lay teddy down as the audience; play softly, then whisper 'good night' and bow.
classes.childAction: Tap softly to the very end, then tuck teddy in.
classes.bridge: The song climbs up and drifts down, ending low, like closing eyes.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song softly, together.
